headline: Faster on big boards, and saves that only write what changed
summary: Boards with hundreds of images stay sharp and feel lighter, saving is quick even for large boards, and undo is instant. Boards saved by 2.1.0 open only in 2.1.0 or later.

new.title: Boards are now two files
new.description: Next to your board file sits Name.refboard.images, which holds your original images. Saving writes only what you added or changed, so a save on a large board takes a moment instead of rewriting everything. Keep the two files together when you move or back up a board. Older boards open as before and switch over the next time you save.

improved.title: Smoother with hundreds of images
improved.description: Hovering, selecting, dragging a marquee, panning and zooming do far less work per frame on large boards.

improved.title: Instant undo
improved.description: Undo and redo now touch only what the step changed, so they are instant on any board and use almost no memory.

improved.title: Lighter autosaves
improved.description: An autosave writes the file once, and moving around the board no longer triggers a full save.

improved.title: Quicker Explorer previews
improved.description: The preview stored with the board comes from images already on screen, so a save no longer re-reads every original.

fixed.title: Images no longer flicker between sharp and blurry
fixed.description: On boards with many images, some images popped soft and sharp while you were not moving. Fixed at the source.

fixed.title: Failed saves no longer leave junk
fixed.description: A save that fails (disk full, a locked file) now keeps your previous file intact and leaves no temporary file behind.

fixed.title: Closing one window no longer skips the unsaved prompt in others
fixed.description: Every window asks about unsaved work, including when you restart to update.

fixed.title: Opening a second window kept its undo history
fixed.description: Opening another board window no longer clears the first window's undo for paint and crop edits.

fixed.title: Small crashes and slips
fixed.description: Pressing Enter with nothing selected, undoing in the middle of a drag, and a rare case where a crash could empty your recent boards list.
